probes: failed → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue))
Re-checked after review 2026-10-14 (18:00 JST runs: fix-*.json). (a) blank photo, live read, both contexts: 'No patients found in the image. Try a clearer photo.' / 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.', nothing added. (b) provider failing (socket), both contexts: 'The photo couldn't be read. Check your connection and try again, or retake the photo.', nothing added. Provider back: the census was re-rendered without the '(synthetic)' heading, the run tag or QA-xxxx MRNs (4 rows, 'QA Alder Hale' …); the read that starts (a byte-identical copy, since the same file starts none — Q10, recorded only) returns {patients: []} / {residents: []}, so the sheet says 'No patients found…' for a clear census. One raw call to the same model (gemini-2.5-flash, ai/providers/vertex:invokeVision) on that image returned all 4 names, inside a ```json fence; a bare JSON.parse of that reply fails. So 'proposes its rows' fails because of the parser, not the fixture. Live calls this run: 5.
Product issue: [census-scan-fenced-json] Photo census reads return no rows: once the provider is back (and on any read), a clear 4-row census gives 'No patients found in the image. Try a clearer photo.' (Hospital) / 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.' (Nursing Home), so the physician cannot add patients from a photo. Cause: the vision model answers with the rows inside a ```json fence and scanCensusSheet parses it with a bare JSON.parse (convex/ai/vision.ts:49 → convex/lib/modelJson.ts:98 parseModelJson returns {} → 0 rows). Same root cause as the dev run's U77 (TC-09 S08): one issue. Breaks OAT-03 S18 'the photo works again once the provider is back' and the TC-02 photo-census path.

descriptionHtml:
Bug B01 · P0 · new

Photo census scan never finds anyone: the vision model wraps its JSON in a ```json block and parseModelJson (convex/lib/modelJson.ts:98) silently returns nothing (Hospital and Nursing Home)

Tickets: TFA-94425 ready for qa; TFA-92580 rejected by qa; TFA-92587 AC 3 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Also blocks dev U77; U78–U81 paused for the same reason Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92587): it also blocks every Nursing Home scan case on dev (TC-09/S04, S06, S07, S08, S17, S18; dev units U77–U81 paused). Re-check 2026-10-16 on 25acd727: still there (convex/ai/vision.ts, modelJson.ts and vertex.ts unchanged since e02167f). With a scripted read, everything after the read passes locally (TC-09/S04, S06, S07, S17); the cases stay failed until a real photo is read. Re-check 2026-10-17 on dev 25acd727 (TFA-92580, TC-02): 14 of 14 photo reads empty while the model answered (gemini-3.6-flash, ok, 2.3–9.9 s); in-process on 25acd727 code a ```json-fenced reply gives 0 rows and bare JSON 3.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-09/S04, TC-09/S06, TC-09/S07, TC-09/S08, TC-09/S17, TC-02/S01, TC-02/S02, TC-02/S06, TC-02/S07, TC-02/S08, TC-02/S14, TC-02/S16

Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S18 Photo capture fails in both contexts: retried, explicit message, nothing added, the photo can be used again

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U11 A failure during photo capture: photo reading retries automatically; if it still fails, a clear message shows, nothing is added, and the photo isn't lost (UAT OAT-03 step 7; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 4; UAT Empty & Failure States (Photo capture); TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-94745 state 7)
  • U13 All of the above in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android (UAT 3.3; UAT Empty & Failure States Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 6)
  • T2 Each error tells the physician what to do next (retry, check connection, enable permission, sign in) in plain language in the app's existing style (TFA-94745 AC 5; TFA-94745 AC 1)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Fresh physician with one existing patient per context; (a) a blank white PNG; (b) a readable synthetic census photo with the vision provider forced to fail as a temporary error

When Open Scan Patient List on the Hospital list and the resident-list scan on the Nursing Home list, and choose each image

Then (a) an explicit no-patients-found message, nothing added. (b) one automatic retry on the server, then an explicit message saying what to do (check the connection, try again or retake), nothing added; choosing the same photo again works once the provider is back

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): (a) The blank image is EFS state 7 (a successful read with zero rows), not a failure: explicit no-patients message, nothing added. (b) is the failure case: an explicit message saying what to do, no 'QA Scan' rows, and choosing the same qa-census-synthetic.png again proposes its three rows once the provider is back (not confirmed). …

Where it ran: local probes (multi-device probes); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S18 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane probes.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: probes.

UAT item: OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-03/S18

Photo capture fails in both contexts: retried, explicit message, nothing added, the photo can be used again

Tickets: TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane probes: status failed in probes/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (probes/plan.json, automatable: partly): Scripted probe both contexts: (a) blank white PNG through the REAL vision path: explicit no-patients message, nothing added; (b) provider failing (socket failure of ai/vision:scanCensusSheet): explicit what-to-do message, nothing added; provider back: choose the same photo again (real read) proposes its rows, not confirmed; whether a same-file pick starts a read is recorded. [Review 2026-10-14] Census rendered by the spec without the '(synthetic)' heading, run tag or QA-xxxx MRNs (names keep 'QA '); one raw invokeVision call (admin, local) records what the model answered for that image. Q10 (same photo again) is recorded only; 'proposes its rows' is judged on the read that starts. — The server's one automatic retry (RT-05) is not observable here (decided in S30); everything the physician sees is judged.

Detail:

Re-checked after review 2026-10-14 (18:00 JST runs: fix-*.json). (a) blank photo, live read, both contexts: 'No patients found in the image. Try a clearer photo.' / 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.', nothing added. (b) provider failing (socket), both contexts: 'The photo couldn't be read. Check your connection and try again, or retake the photo.', nothing added. Provider back: the census was re-rendered without the '(synthetic)' heading, the run tag or QA-xxxx MRNs (4 rows, 'QA Alder Hale' …); the read that starts (a byte-identical copy, since the same file starts none — Q10, recorded only) returns {patients: []} / {residents: []}, so the sheet says 'No patients found…' for a clear census. One raw call to the same model (gemini-2.5-flash, ai/providers/vertex:invokeVision) on that image returned all 4 names, inside a ```json fence; a bare JSON.parse of that reply fails. So 'proposes its rows' fails because of the parser, not the fixture. Live calls this run: 5.

Product issue: [census-scan-fenced-json] Photo census reads return no rows: once the provider is back (and on any read), a clear 4-row census gives 'No patients found in the image. Try a clearer photo.' (Hospital) / 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.' (Nursing Home), so the physician cannot add patients from a photo. Cause: the vision model answers with the rows inside a ```json fence and scanCensusSheet parses it with a bare JSON.parse (convex/ai/vision.ts:49 → convex/lib/modelJson.ts:98 parseModelJson returns {} → 0 rows). Same root cause as the dev run's U77 (TC-09 S08): one issue. Breaks OAT-03 S18 'the photo works again once the provider is back' and the TC-02 photo-census path.

Recorded-only cells (recorded): {"Q10":"choosing the SAME photo again starts no read (Chromium); whether that counts as 'the photo isn't lost' is Daniela's call"}

Evidence: 4 attached; 2 not attached:

  • probes/evidence/oat03-s18/snf-b-again.aria.yml — .yml files are not attached
  • probes/media/census-hosp-neutral.jpg — .jpg files are not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Part (b) needs a seam that fails photo reading (invokeVision) on the deployment and can be switched off between steps (fault-ai); no such switch may be set on dev (no env change, no action mock; runner-contract §10, Q12).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
